schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, COPIES INT, REQUESTOR VARCHAR(255), QUEUE_DATE DATETIME, PRINT_LOCATION INT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (CORRESPONDENCE_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, FILE_NUMBER INT)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, COPIES, REQUESTOR, QUEUE_DATE, PRINT_LOCATION) SELECT n, n*10, MOD(n, 5), CONCAT('Requestor_', n), DATEADD(DAY, -MOD(n, 30), GETDATE()), MOD(n, 3) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (CORRESPONDENCE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, FILE_NUMBER) SELECT n, n*10, n FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
